title: Silanus
summary: Raleigh names Silanus in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Silanus the Sooth-sayer, who had receiued a great reward of Cyrus, and who diuulged Xenophon his purpose of building a Citie. The printed spelling is kept. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book III, Part I, Chapter X, §. XIII, sig. 443a–443b
